concepts.gloss_en: Night; the aspect of darkness/constriction (חושך, poverty and hardship) when 'the end of all flesh' rules
Circumcision; the covenant (ברית), as in חשמ"ל = חש מל and קדושת הברית

notes: Not the same concept. Mechanical grouping was driven only by orthographic resemblance (shared -ילה ending). לילה = night/darkness; מילה = circumcision/covenant. Entirely distinct referents, no shared usage.
